meta.title: DSH peak/off-peak badge
meta.description: Shows whether the DeepSeek API is billing at peak or off-peak rates in every session header and on the blank new-session home. Hover or focus the badge for the next switch, the Beijing-time peak windows, and the 2×/1× difference; click it to open the official pricing page. The rule is computed in UTC with Chinese public holidays built in and refreshed by CI.
